method: Read-only public GitHub search and pinned source inspection, before any new model comparison. These repositories are reserved for pipeline exploration and excluded from the confirmatory corpus.

repositories.observation: The exact-selector collector was rerun on all ten named Cypress specs: five returned zero leads, problem_creator.cy.ts returned one, contest.cy.ts five, navigation.cy.ts one, and course_2Part.cy.ts four; ide.cy.ts exited 2/INCOMPLETE at the 20-lead cap. The apparent course navigation reuse at course_2Part.cy.ts:298-300 checks an unlisted-but-joinable course before direct entry; coursePage.enterCourse() navigates away and starts an assignment, so it cannot replace that intermediate observation. The profile-menu click at navigation.cy.ts:81 leads to enrolled contests, unlike the profile-edit Page Object methods. Contest date fields and virtual-contest links likewise lack proven equivalent workflows. No positive ownership label was established; ide.cy.ts remains incompletely collected.

The inspected raw selector uses are largely assertions or commented-out actions; no positive ownership label was established. A later collector sweep of all fourteen named cypress/e2e specs against cypress/support returned zero exact-selector leads; this is not a semantic clean label.
The inspected spec uses Page Object members consistently; a GitHub code search returned no direct cy.get result under cypress/e2e. This is not a full-source clean label.

Expanded Playwright-layout screening found a source-supported #13 candidate: mpr2.spec.ts:17 directly clicks side-panel-header-right, while RightPanelPageObject.ts:235-237 exposes toggle() with that exact click; fixture.ts provides the same-page object, and RTHydrationFromMPR.spec.ts:17 uses it. Bundled named-file scanner exited 0 but emitted no #13 lead; its automatic collector targets named Cypress specs. This is one natural workflow candidate, not an independently adjudicated label or a model result.

Relaxed Cypress-layout screening found virtual-machine.spec.ts:226-237 directly clicking Create while virtualmachine.po.ts:189-204 has save() with the same click. The spec needs the create response body for image export, whereas save() consumes it and returns nothing: direct method reuse is unsafe, but the established same-page workflow may still support a #13 ownership finding with an adapted method. Keep this DEBATABLE, not a negative gold label. In advanced.spec.ts:34,83,121 the matching advanced-tab click is inside a read-only config observation, while the POM click at virtualmachine.po.ts:182 is inside mutating setValue(); advanced.spec.ts:197-205 uses a prefix search for multirow cleanup, while the POM search at :295-305 opens one VM's Config. Those partial-workflow matches are also DEBATABLE, not confirmed positives or negatives.
